volunteerExperiences.description:
Out of LinkedIn’s 20,000 employees, I’m part of  a special community of 250 Culture Champions ‒ employees who go beyond their day job to create exceptional experiences that bring our culture to life around our 37+ global offices and throughout our remote community. ​
​
How do we do it? Once a month, LinkedIn gives employees a day to invest in themselves and their communities. We call it InVestment Day, or InDay for short. It’s a day for connection, collaboration and co-creation. ​

As a Culture Champion, I bring this global tradition to life in a meaningful way 12 times a year. Outside my official LinkedIn role, I work with peers and leaders to plan and execute experiences for our employees. If you’re curious about LinkedIn’s Culture Champion or InDay programs, message me and I’ll tell you more!​

Volunteer tour guide for San Francisco Public Library program that offers free historical walking tours throughout the city. Since 1978, SF City Guides has preserved and perpetuated the history and folklore of San Francisco, and celebrated its rich history of cultural diversity.
